title: Balancing product protection, premium appeal and recyclability in skincare packaging
summary: The skincare market is facing increasing demands for both product performance and sustainability. As formulations become more sophisticated and ingredient-sensitive, packaging is expected to provide effective product protection while supporting recyclability and delivering a premium consumer experience
